program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cells (find-color g 3))
                  (marks (find-color g 6))
                  (r0 (min-of fst cells))
                  (r1 (max-of fst cells))
                  (c0 (min-of snd cells))
                  (c1 (max-of snd cells))
                  (above (filter (lambda (p)
                                   (and (< (fst p) r0) (>= (snd p) c0) (<= (snd p) c1)))
                                 marks))
                  (below (filter (lambda (p)
                                   (and (> (fst p) r1) (>= (snd p) c0) (<= (snd p) c1)))
                                 marks))
                  (lefts (filter (lambda (p) (< (snd p) c0)) marks))
                  (rights (filter (lambda (p) (> (snd p) c1)) marks))
                  (nr0 (if (empty? above) r0 (+ 1 (max-of fst above))))
                  (nr1 (if (empty? below) r1 (- (min-of fst below) 1)))
                  (nc0 (if (empty? lefts) c0 (+ 1 (max-of snd lefts))))
                  (nc1 (if (empty? rights) c1 (- (min-of snd rights) 1)))
                  (full-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                       (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 3))
                                             (range c0 (+ c1 1))))
                                     (range r0 (+ r1 1))))
                  (full-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                       (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 3))
                                             (range r0 (+ r1 1))))
                                     (range c0 (+ c1 1))))
                  (base (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v 6) 6 0))))
             (define (map-r r) (cond ((= r r0) nr0) ((= r r1) nr1) (else r)))
             (define (map-c c) (cond ((= c c0) nc0) ((= c c1) nc1) (else c)))
             (define (paint-h acc r)
               (reduce (lambda (a c) (set-cell a r c 3)) acc (range nc0 (+ nc1 1))))
             (define (paint-v acc c)
               (reduce (lambda (a r) (set-cell a r c 3)) acc (range nr0 (+ nr1 1))))
             (recolor-cells (reduce (lambda (acc c) (paint-v acc (map-c c)))
                                    (reduce (lambda (acc r) (paint-h acc (map-r r)))
                                            base
                                            full-rows)
                                    full-cols)
                            marks
                            6)))))
